text:
Arjun K: heads-up, we're seeing a spike in pod connection failures in eu-west-2 GPU cluster since the 03:00 deploy. Lots of restarts on inference workers.
Nora: logs? HTTP 502 / ECONNRESET?
Arjun K: mostly ECONNRESET and "connection refused" when talking to external model cache and S3. node kernel logs show nf_conntrack table full.
Samir: how full? can you paste conntrack -S and /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max?
Arjun K: ran on node gpu-eu2-09:
```
# conntrack -S
entries: 65536
entries-hr: 65536
# cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max
65536
# conntrack -L | wc -l
65010
```
Lia: that is basically saturated. pattern looks like high churn of short-lived outbound connections (model prefetch + telemetry).
Matt P: eu-west2 GPU autoscaler just spun up 30 pods in 10m for a new release, each pod pulls models and hits a TCP-heavy flow. SNAT on nodes plus ephemeral ports exhaustion = conntrack pressure.
Nora: also check ip_local_port_range and tcp_tw_reuse/tcp_tw_recycle.
Arjun K: ip_local_port_range is default: "32768 60999". tcp_tw_reuse=0.
Samir: immediate mitigation options: 1) increase nf_conntrack_max; 2) expand ip_local_port_range; 3) reduce outbound connection churn (prefetch throttling / shared cache); 4) put heavy egress through a NAT gateway with connection pooling; 5) move kube-proxy to ipvs mode to reduce conntrack?
Lia: ipvs won't remove conntrack for SNAT to internet. It helps service side but not egress NAT. For SNAT we need either source-side pooling or a dedicated egress gateway that reuses ephemeral ports.
infra-oncall-bot: ACTION STARTED: increasing nf_conntrack_max on gpu nodes (temporary) and adding traffic-sampling rule.
Matt P: I ran: sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144 and echo "10240 65535" > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range on gpu-eu2-*. cc @infra-oncall-bot.
Arjun K: after change conntrack entries dropped to ~70k used? we still saw some drops for older sockets in TIME_WAIT. tcp_tw_reuse=1 helped reclaim earlier.
Nora: please don't enable tcp_tw_recycle (broken with NAT). tcp_tw_reuse=1 is ok.
Samir: medium-term: add egress proxy (squid or pooler) for model downloads and telemetry, and prepull images/models into node-local cache so pod launches don't hammer outbound. Also consider conntrackd with high availability.
Lia: also check MTU: I saw occasional fragmentation for model shards via an intermediate LB (MTU mismatch). fragmentation increases conntrack entries because of retransmissions on TCP. MTU on gpu nodes is 1500 but ENI is 9000 for some hosts; mismatch confirmed on a subset.
Matt P: fixed MTU mismatch on two nodes (set 9000). will monitor.
Arjun K: question about RDMA: our eu-west2 GPU pool doesn't use RoCE, so RDMA bypass isn't applicable. if we did RoCE then egress TCP wouldn't touch conntrack, but not our case.
Nora: can we throttle the prefetch? deployment roll back or config tweak?
Samir: set PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=2 for the new release via k8s rollout pause/patch. That instantly reduced new connections by ~60%.
infra-oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: root cause = ephemeral port / conntrack exhaustion driven by concurrent model prefetch on many short-lived pods after autoscale. Mitigations applied: increased nf_conntrack_max, expanded ip_local_port_range, corrected MTU, throttled prefetch.
Lia: follow-ups: 1) ticket to add egress pooling (ENG-PLAT-3456); 2) runbook update for conntrack saturation (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/conntrack-saturation); 3) add node sysctl default bump for gpu pools.
Matt P: I'll open ENG-PLAT-3456 and schedule a postmortem sync.
Arjun K: thanks all — things look stable, dropping error rate from ~18% to <1% after fixes. will keep an eye and revert ephemeral sysctl to infra config if needed.
Nora: nice work. please add the exact sysctl commands and dates to the runbook so oncall can act faster next time.
infra-oncall-bot: ACTION CLOSED: temporary fixes applied. Follow-up ticket assigned to Matt P (ENG-PLAT-3456).
